title: Concept: Lockfile integrity recorded with SHA-1
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile whose integrity value is a SHA-1 digest, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: SHA-1 collisions are practical for a motivated attacker, so the digest cannot prove that the installed tarball is the one the lockfile recorded.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: SHA-1 collisions are practical for a motivated attacker, so the digest cannot prove that the installed tarball is the one the lockfile recorded.
